entries.title: Hetzner cuts traffic on US VPSs, raises prices
entries.author: hyperknot
entries.current_title: Hetzner cuts traffic on US VPSs, raises prices
entries.excerpt: Just received by email: We are writing to inform you about important changes to the tariff structure of our Cloud servers (CCX and CPX lines) and our Load balancers at our US locations in Ashburn and Hillsboro. What will change? Starting on 1 December 2024, 01:00 am CET, we will begin charging new prices for newly-created Cloud servers and introduce new amounts for included traffic for Cloud Servers and Load balancers at the US locations in Ashburn (ASH) and Hillsboro (HIL).
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者转述 Hetzner 调价邮件，称美国 VPS 将减少流量额度并提高价格。

entries.title: YubiKey still selling old stock with vulnerable firmware
entries.author: MaKey
entries.current_title: YubiKey still selling old stock with vulnerable firmware
entries.excerpt: FYI, YubiKey is apparently still selling old stock with firmware vulnerable to the EUCLEAK attack instead of disposing of them, as a reader of Fefe's Blog reported: https://blog.fefe.de/?ts=99ccc8dc

entries.title: Launch HN: Codebuff (YC F24) – CLI tool that writes code for you
entries.author: jahooma
entries.current_title: Launch HN: Codebuff (YC F24) – CLI tool that writes code for you
entries.excerpt: Hey HN! We’re James and Brandon building Codebuff ( https://codebuff.com ). Codebuff is like Cursor Composer, but in your terminal: it modifies files based on your natural language requests. You can try it with `npm i -g codebuff` and start using it immediately for free. We have no login gate, and we give all accounts up to $20 worth of credits. Codebuff is different because we simplified the input to one step: you type what you want done in your terminal and hit enter. Then
entries.guide_zh: Codebuff 展示命令行编程助手，让用户通过终端请求 AI 修改代码。
